channel.title: Fun activities to do in Nature for kids
channel.description: Outdoor nature games, wildlife walks and observation activities for families.

item.title: Nature sketching for kids: draw one discovery on a mini biodiversity survey
item.description: Do we have to name everything we see? Choose one small patch of park or garden, count the different living things you notice and sketch one discovery. A leaf shape or a bird silhouette is enough to begin. Try the free Mini Biodiversity Survey.

media:content.media:description: A green and red bird and a smaller side view appear on an inset naturalist plate above a field-sketch prompt.

item.title: Outdoor listening activity for kids who want to map birdsong
item.description: How can kids tell which sounds are near or far? Sit quietly outside for five minutes. Draw a dot for yourself, then mark a bird call, rustling leaves or passing footsteps around it. Try the free sound map.

media:content.media:description: A brightly coloured bird on a branch sits beside a diagram with three rings around a listening spot.
